anti_overlap: Do NOT produce an illocutionary-force taxonomy — assertive/directive/commissive/expressive, locution/illocution/perlocution, rhetorical-question analysis, presupposition accommodation. fd-pragmatics-illocutionary-force owns the act-type cut and spent it (f-001..f-004); the fusion lens re-adjudicated it (f-022, f-023). Your surface-versus-root section must be about which of two contradicting channels a definition trusts, never about what kind of act an utterance is.

Do NOT analyse veridicality, the use/mention distinction, propositional attitude reports, factuality-value schemes, or attribution markup. fd-semantics-propositional-veridicality owns that (f-005..f-008). True-and-false presentation in your sense is a channel discordance, not a factuality value; do not build an annotation scheme.

Do NOT model commitment stores, deontic scorekeeping, entitlement, retraction obligations, sincerity conditions, or the knowledge norm of assertion. fd-dialectics-commitment-accountability owns those (f-009..f-012), including the settled result that retraction utility belongs downstream of the gate. 'Standing constitution' in your sense is an empirical regularity in the corpus, not a normative score — keep it that way.

Do NOT use over-extension/under-extension (ativyapti/avyapti/asambhava) as defect vocabulary and do NOT run a counter-instance demolition of each candidate definition. fd-lakshana-definition-extension owns definition-testing as a method (f-013..f-017). Assume its length-monotonicity and fragment-leak results; build on them rather than re-deriving them.

Do NOT analyse prob buckets, mass, the trustworthy flag, thresholds, tolerance bands, quantisation, calibration, or the base-rate/denominator question. fd-assay-fineness-warrant owns instrument and standard (f-018..f-021). You may cite its numbers, including the 79.8%-at-prob-1.0 figure, as evidence that a sign is common; you may not re-measure them and you may not propose a threshold.

Do NOT reason in bearing faces, joints, joint families, axes, datums, dry assembly, or joinability. fd-kigumi-mating-geometry owns the structural-mating cut and spent it last round (f-024..f-026), including the self-reply temporal collapse and the root-claim scarcity. Cite those numbers as constraints on your ranking; do not restate the geometry, and do not re-derive the time-dispersion measurement.

Do NOT restate the four known symptoms (questions scoring YES, 'holy heck' as a claim, the ~34% rate, the conflated rubric predicate) as findings. All four are in the ledger. They are your raw material for the informativeness argument, not results.

Do NOT drift into medical claims, treatment reasoning, or defending the tradition's ontology. You are borrowing a method of sign selection and channel arbitration, nothing else. Any sentence that would need a clinical citation to stand is out of scope.

Do NOT redesign gate_prompt.py, the extraction rubric, or pairing.py. The one structural remedy you are permitted is a single paragraph in the final review area, and this craft's remedy is almost always 'read a second channel', not 'rebuild the instrument'.
decision_lens: Rank each candidate definition of 'claim' by DISCRIMINATING YIELD, in this order: (1) signs-per-pattern — how many rows the definition admits divided by how many distinct standing positions of this author those rows actually reveal; a definition admitting 16,082 rows that resolve to a few dozen recurring positions is admitting common signs and is worse than one admitting a tenth as many rows across the same positions; (2) channel economy — how many of the four independently available channels the definition requires, and whether the pipeline persists each one, since a definition that needs a channel the pipeline discards is undiagnosable rather than merely strict; (3) surface-versus-root discipline — whether the definition reads the presentation or the root, and whether it survives the corpus's real inversions (bare-handle posts, catchphrases, jokes carrying positions); (4) discordance doctrine — whether the definition states, in advance, which channel to abandon when two conflict, and whether it can tell a discordance that NAMES a pattern from one that is instrument failure. A definition that admits many signs but reveals few patterns loses to one that admits few signs and separates patterns cleanly. Every ranking claim must land on quoted rows with uri, text, label, prob, and created_at where time is in play.
distance_rationale: A pre-modern, non-Western clinical epistemology whose native question is neither what an utterance does, nor whether it is true, nor what its speaker owes, nor whether a definition is well-formed, nor whether an object meets a standard, nor whether two members can be joined. Its native question is: WHICH OBSERVATIONS ARE WORTH WRITING DOWN, given that a sign carries no meaning alone and earns its place only by discriminating between candidate patterns — and what do you do when two channels of observation contradict each other. It shares no vocabulary, literature, or method with philosophy of language, corpus linguistics, metrology, definition-theory, or structural carpentry. Two things make it maximally distant here. First, every lens already spent judges ADMISSIBILITY (is this thing a claim / does it bear / does it assay / does it join); this craft judges INFORMATIVENESS — a sign that is present in every pattern, however genuine and however strongly present, is near-worthless, and the physician's skill is discarding true signs that discriminate nothing. That is precisely the half of the acceptance criterion ('found things I DIDN'T NOTICE') that no covered lens has served; they all serve only 'those can't both be right.' Second, the craft inverts the project's stance on contradiction: mai zheng bu fu, the moment two channels disagree, is not an error to resolve but the highest-value diagnostic event, and the tradition has explicit rules for which channel to abandon. This pipeline treats contradiction as its output and has no doctrine at all for the contradictions inside its own instrument.
expected_isomorphisms: si zhen he can, the rule that four independent examinations must be cross-referenced and that a physician reading one of the four is simply incompetent ≅ the gate reading a single channel (own text, optionally with a rendered context block) while data/posts.jsonl independently carries at least four: own text; thread shape (root vs reply vs quote, and parent DID self vs foreign); createdAt (cadence, hour, burst structure — the 36-second median self-reply gap f-024 measured); and the author's own standing corpus of 53,783 posts. Common signs, the ones present in every pattern and therefore near-diagnostically-worthless ≅ the 12,837 claim rows sitting at prob rounding to 1.0 (79.8% of the claim set) — a certification that fires on four fifths of everything it admits discriminates nothing. Cardinal / pathognomonic sign, the one whose presence alone moves the diagnosis ≅ a post that, once read, changes what you would predict about the rest of the corpus. zhen han jia re, true cold presenting as false heat — a sign whose surface reads as its own opposite, where the entire craft is knowing when to trust the surface and when the root ≅ 'holy heck' certified as a defensible position, the 72 rows (5.8% of 1,251) whose ENTIRE own text is a bare @-handle and which score claim at p up to 0.97, and conversely the argued position wearing a joke. biao/ben, branch versus root, where acute presentations are treated at the branch and chronic ones at the root ≅ whether 'claim' names the occasion of an utterance or the standing position it expresses. ti zhi, the constitution — the standing disposition a sign must be read against, without which no sign has a reading ≅ the author's persistent positions, which the pipeline never builds and which contradiction must ultimately be against. wen zhen, asking, the one examination that is the patient's own report rather than the physician's reading, weighed differently from what is observed directly ≅ hedges and epistemic markers as self-report, a different evidence class from observed content. wang shen, reading the whole person's spirit as a gestalt before any particular sign ≅ reading the corpus's shape before scoring a post. tong bing yi zhi / yi bing tong zhi, same disease treated differently and different diseases treated the same ≅ byte-identical text drawing opposite verdicts (f-015), which the craft says is defensible only if you can NAME the differing pattern, and otherwise is instrument failure.
focus: Informativeness rather than admissibility: for each rival sense of 'claim', how much does its survivor set actually tell you about this author that you did not already know, how many independent channels does it require versus how many the pipeline reads, and what is its rule for which channel to abandon when two of them contradict each other.
name: fd-bianzheng-discriminating-sign
persona: Apply the perspective of a physician trained in the Shanghan Lun tradition of pattern differentiation. You do not diagnose from a symptom list. You take four examinations — you look, you listen and smell, you ask, and you palpate — and the tradition holds that a physician who reads one of the four and calls it a diagnosis is not practising. A sign has no meaning in isolation: it means something only inside a pattern, and its worth is exactly its power to distinguish one candidate pattern from another. Fatigue is real, present, and nearly worthless, because it is present in every pattern. You spend your training learning which true signs to discard. You know that a sign can present as its own opposite — true cold showing a flushed face and a thirst for warm drinks — so the surface and the root can point in contrary directions, and reading the surface confidently is the classic novice error. You read every presentation against the patient's standing constitution, because the same sign in two constitutions is two different findings. And when the pulse and the presentation do not correspond, you do not panic and you do not average: that discordance is the most informative event in the encounter, and the tradition gives you a rule — abandon the pulse and follow the signs, or abandon the signs and follow the pulse, but say which and why. You reason in signs, channels, patterns and discordances. You have no theory of meaning, truth, force, or definition, and you do not need one, because you are asking the question this review has not asked: not whether an observation is genuine, but whether writing it down tells anyone anything.
review_areas: CHANNEL AUDIT (si zhen he can). Enumerate every channel data/posts.jsonl and data/gate.jsonl make independently readable — own text; thread shape (root / plain reply / quote / reply+quote, and parent DID self vs foreign); createdAt as cadence and hour and burst structure; and the author's own standing corpus — and state exactly which of them each pipeline stage reads. Then, for EACH of the five candidate definitions, state which channels it requires and whether the pipeline persists them, marking each definition undiagnosable, diagnosable-as-built, or diagnosable-with-a-named-cheap-addition. Anchor on the bare-handle rows: 72 of 1,251 mention-only posts are certified as asserting something defensible, which is what single-channel reading produces when a second channel (own-text-minus-mentions is empty) would have settled it in one line. Do not propose a threshold and do not analyse prob buckets; this is a channel-availability audit, not an instrument audit.

COMMON SIGN VERSUS CARDINAL SIGN — the signs-per-pattern measurement. This is the decisive number in the review; compute it first. A sign present in every pattern discriminates nothing however genuine it is. Operationalise redundancy on real rows: 16,082 claims carry 16,001 distinct own-texts, so surface uniqueness is near-total and tells you nothing — measure PROPOSITIONAL redundancy instead. Choose a cheap defensible method (content-word overlap, shared rare-term signatures, or the embeddings the pipeline already builds if data/claims.json or an embedding path is usable) and report, for the claim set as a whole and then per candidate definition: how many rows, how many distinguishable recurring positions those rows resolve to, and the ratio. State your method and its error direction plainly; an approximate number with a stated method beats a precise number about the wrong thing. Then name, with uris and text, five rows that are pure common signs (true, present, discriminating nothing about this author) and five that are cardinal (reading them changes what you would predict about the rest of the corpus). The definition that maximises cardinal yield per admitted row wins this section, and this section should dominate the final ranking.

TRUE-AND-FALSE PRESENTATION (zhen jia). The classic novice error is trusting the presentation when surface and root oppose. Sample real rows in both directions and quantify each as best you can: presentations that read as assertion with no root (bare handles, catchphrases such as 'so jot that down', bare agreements, exclamatives), and roots that present as something else (a position stated inside a joke, a wager, or a compliment). For each candidate definition, state whether it reads presentation or root, and show the corpus punishing that choice with quoted counter-examples. Strict constraint: this is NOT a speech-act taxonomy and NOT a factuality scheme — do not classify by illocutionary type, do not use assertive/directive/expressive vocabulary, do not build asserted/hedged/quoted annotation values. The only question here is which of two contradicting channels a definition trusts, and what it costs on real rows.

CONSTITUTION VERSUS EPISODE (ti zhi and biao/ben). No sign has a reading without a constitution to read it against. For each candidate definition, state whether 'claim' names a property of the post (episode) or a property of the post's relation to the author's standing positions (constitution). Then test it: take a sample of high-prob claims and determine, on real data, whether the same position appears elsewhere in the corpus, and whether the pipeline anywhere constructs a standing set of positions for this author. If it does not, say plainly which candidate definitions are therefore uncomputable as stated, and which merely become expensive. Connect this to the ranker's shape without re-deriving it: surprise() multiplies temporal_factor, so a constitution-relative definition needs positions that persist across the 180-day half-life, and f-024/f-026 have already measured how little of the claim set is time-dispersed at all. The question you own is whether the CONSTITUTION exists to be contradicted, not whether individual pairs are far enough apart.

DISCORDANCE DOCTRINE (mai zheng bu fu, she mai cong zheng). The tradition's most valuable event is two channels contradicting each other, and its discipline is that you must state in advance which channel you abandon. Apply this at two levels. First, INSIDE the instrument: the pipeline currently has live discordances it has no rule for — a claim label at p=0.97 against own text that is a bare handle; byte-identical text drawing opposite verdicts (f-015); has_context=false rows scoring HIGHER (42.0%) than has_context=true rows (37.5%) despite context being the thing that supposedly supplies propositional content. For each, say which channel a competent reader abandons and why. Second, ACROSS the candidate definitions: state each definition's discordance rule in one sentence of the form 'when the surface and the root disagree, follow X'. A definition with no such rule is five definitions wearing one name and should be marked so. Critically, the craft distinguishes a discordance that NAMES a pattern from a discordance that reveals instrument failure — the whole product depends on this distinction and the pipeline currently cannot draw it. Say which candidate definition best equips it to, and what the cheapest discriminator would be.

PROGNOSIS AND WHAT THIS CRAFT CANNOT SEE. State plainly, for your top-ranked definition: where it discards posts the author himself would call claims and why that is the right trade; how thin its survivor set gets, in real row counts, and whether that is still enough to fill a ranked feed given what f-024 and f-026 measured about time dispersion; and one paragraph — no more — on the cheapest structural remedy, which for this craft is almost always 'read a second channel' rather than 'redesign the instrument'. Then state the honest limit: name at least two dimensions of the problem that a diagnostic frame is constitutionally blind to, and say which already-spent lens sees each of them better. You are being asked which sense of the word 'claim' this system should mean, not to redesign the pipeline.

DELIVERABLE SHAPE. Finish with the five rival definitions stated in a fixed form and ranked: 'a claim is X; it reads channels Y; its discordance rule is follow Z when surface and root disagree; on real data it admits N rows resolving to M distinguishable positions.' A definition that cannot be stated in that form has not been stated. Rank them by discriminating yield, show the ranking is not merely the admissibility ranking the previous six lenses would have produced, and where your ranking disagrees with an existing ledger finding, say so explicitly and cite the finding id — a contradiction of a spent finding is worth more here than an agreement.

severity_examples.condition: Escalate to P0 only when the signs-per-pattern ratio is computed by a stated method over the real claim set AND at least three concrete high-scoring candidate pairs are shown to be restatements of a position the author states repeatedly elsewhere, with uris. Argued from the redundancy intuition alone, or from the 79.8%-at-prob-1.0 figure alone, this is P1.
severity_examples.scenario: The claim set is measured to be propositionally near-degenerate: 16,082 admitted rows resolve to so few distinguishable standing positions that the ranked feed cannot contain a surprise for the author, because every pair the system can build restates a position he has stated many times and already knows he holds. The system would then satisfy 'those can't both be right' while structurally failing 'found things I didn't notice' — passing its own tests and failing its only acceptance criterion.

severity_examples.condition: P1 when the channel audit shows the defect class is cross-channel and at least two candidate definitions are shown to be text-only as stated. Raise to P0 only if the top-ranked definition is demonstrated to be extensionally indistinguishable from the current gate on a sampled set of real rows.
severity_examples.scenario: Every candidate definition is single-channel — each is stated as a property readable from the post's own text — while the corpus makes at least three further channels independently available and the observed defects (bare-handle claims, the length monotonicity, the self-reply time collapse) are all cross-channel defects invisible from text alone. Ranking five single-channel definitions then selects the best of a family that cannot see the actual failure, and the winner will look defensible and behave exactly like the current gate.

severity_examples.condition: P2 when the missing rule is shown on real rows to produce two different extensions for the same definition. Raise to P1 if the definition ranked first is the one missing the rule.
severity_examples.scenario: A definition is ranked well on discriminating yield while having no discordance rule, so it silently trusts whichever channel the implementation happens to read first. It behaves consistently on the sampled rows only because the sample under-represents surface-root inversions, and its extension will move the moment context resolution, logging, or prompt rendering changes — the same class of instability f-015 already observed on identical text.

source_domain: Classical Chinese clinical pattern-differentiation (bian zheng lun zhi) in the Shanghan Lun / Wenbing tradition — the four examinations (si zhen: looking, listening-and-smelling, asking, palpating) and their mandatory cross-reference (si zhen he can); the eight-principle grid (ba gang) as a discriminating frame; the twenty-eight pulse images read at cun/guan/chi positions and floating/middle/deep levels; cardinal versus common signs (zhu zheng vs the signs that appear in every pattern); true-and-false presentation (zhen han jia re — a sign presenting as its own opposite); root-and-branch priority (biao/ben); standing constitution (ti zhi) versus episodic presentation; and the classical doctrine for irreconcilable channels, mai zheng bu fu (pulse and presentation do not correspond) resolved by she mai cong zheng / she zheng cong mai — abandon the pulse and follow the signs, or abandon the signs and follow the pulse
success_hints: Read the heat ledger before anything else, then gate_prompt.py's INSTRUCTIONS and SHOTS, then context.py's as_prompt_block(), then pairing.py's surprise(). The ledger tells you which 26 observations are spent; a finding that duplicates one scores zero novelty. Extend one, contradict one, or find ground none of them touched — and the untouched ground is informativeness, not admissibility.

Compute the signs-per-pattern ratio first and let it reframe everything else. Every other lens has counted rows admitted; you are the only one counting positions revealed. If the ratio is bad, that single number outranks the entire rest of the review and should be stated in the first paragraph of your output.

Every assertion must land on quoted rows — uri, own text, label, prob, and created_at wherever time is in play. A diagnostic metaphor without a uri attached is decoration and will be scored as zero novelty. The four-examinations framing earns its keep only by naming which specific field in which specific file each channel comes from.

State each of the five definitions in a form that names its channels and its discordance rule, not just its criterion. 'A claim is a post with propositional content' is not a definition in this craft's sense until you say what you read to detect it and what you do when two readings disagree.

Be willing to say that a true, sincere, well-formed assertion is diagnostically worthless. That verdict is the craft's central move and is the one thing this review can contribute that the six spent lenses structurally cannot — they all reward genuineness. Do not soften it into 'lower priority'; say the sign is common and should be discarded, and show the rows.

If your ranking contradicts a spent ledger finding, say so explicitly with the finding id and your counter-evidence. Contradiction of a spent finding is the highest-value output available to a round-2 STEER-WIDE lens; agreement restated in new vocabulary is the lowest.

Keep the craft vocabulary thin in the output. Use the Chinese terms where they carry a distinction English lacks (common vs cardinal sign, surface vs root, discordance doctrine) and drop them everywhere else. The reader needs the cut, not the costume.
task_context:
What does 'claim' mean in this pipeline? The gate (src/norvid_studier/gate_prompt.py) sorts 40,943 prefiltered Bluesky posts into claim/nonclaim and has now scored ~42.7k of them into data/gate.jsonl (each line: uri, then a nested 'data' object with label, prob, mass, top_token, trustworthy, text, created_at, has_context). Downstream, extract_prompt.py turns each claim into a 'commitment', pairing.py finds candidate contradictory pairs, and tension_prompt.py judges them. The acceptance criterion for the whole system is norvid_studies' words: 'found things I didn't notice but upon juxtaposition oh yeah those cant both be right'. Determine the top 5 candidate DEFINITIONS of 'claim' the gate could be operating on — not five example claims, five rival senses of the word — and rank them by how well each serves that acceptance criterion. Ground every candidate in the ACTUAL scored data: read data/gate.jsonl and data/posts.jsonl, sample real posts at various prob levels, and show which definition each real verdict is consistent with. Known symptoms to explain: questions still score YES despite an explicit NO rule; 'holy heck' scores as a claim; ~34% claim rate is ~10x the design estimate of belief-bearing posts (~3%); the rubric asks for 'asserts something that could be true or false, and that its author could be asked to defend' which conflates at least assertion-vs-question, proposition-vs-speech-act, and defensible-vs-sincere. Read docs/brainstorms/2026-07-29-norvid-studier-brainstorm.md for prior reasoning.

This review contributes the round-2 STEER-WIDE track of a flux-melange loop. Twenty-six scored findings already exist in docs/research/flux-melange/norvid-studier-claim-definition/heat-ledger.jsonl — READ IT FIRST, it is the map of what is already spent. Six lenses have been used: illocutionary force (f-001..f-004), formal-semantic veridicality (f-005..f-008), dialectical commitment (f-009..f-012), Navya-Nyaya definition-testing (f-013..f-017), metallurgical assay (f-018..f-021), a fusion adjudicating f-001 against f-014 (f-022..f-023), and structural joinability (f-024..f-026). EVERY ONE of them asks an admissibility question — is this post a claim, does it bear a predicate, does it meet the standard, can it be joined. NONE asks whether admitting a post tells anyone anything they did not already know, which is what 'found things I didn't notice' literally requires. That is your ground.

Assume and build on these established facts rather than re-deriving them: 42,669 scored rows, 16,082 claims (37.7%); claim rate is a monotonic function of raw own-text length, 8.6% under 20 chars to 82.7% at 200+ (f-013); prob takes only 40 distinct values and mass never varies (f-018, f-019); question-final posts leak at ~27% (f-014, f-022); sub-40-char fragments are 13.6% of claims (f-016); quote-posts are suppressed to 10-13% claim rate (f-017); gate.jsonl logs bare own text, not the resolved block actually scored (f-008); self-reply claims are 30.2% of claims but 97.4% land within an hour of their parent so surprise() zeroes them (f-024); 691 foreign-reply claims carry <=4 of the subject's own words (f-025); only 539 root claims (3.4%) are both same-author and time-dispersed (f-026). New anchors measured for you, verified, that no ledger entry covers: of 1,251 posts whose entire own text is nothing but @-handles and punctuation, 72 (5.8%) are labelled claim, at probabilities up to 0.9707 (e.g. at://did:plc:mssgex5rqek4wc66wgvzztbc/app.bsky.feed.post/3mq5uob65ys2z, text '@yonderdavid.bsky.social', has_context true); 12,837 of 16,082 claims (79.8%) sit at prob rounding to 1.0; claim rate is 37.5% for has_context=true rows and 42.0% for the 1,357 has_context=false rows; among 16,082 claim rows there are 16,001 distinct own-texts, so near-total surface uniqueness coexists with the possibility of near-total propositional redundancy — which is exactly the measurement this lens exists to make. data/posts.jsonl records carry value.text, value.langs, value.reply.root/parent uris, value.embed, and value.createdAt, and nothing else — no engagement counts. pairing.py's surprise() is confidence x temporal_factor x topical_distance, all multiplicands, with HALF_LIFE_DAYS gating the temporal term and 0.0 at zero days apart.
